kind: Native unchanged-body bytecode control-flow audit; not a live trial

facts.fact: Calls UUID duplicate disconnect and waits when duplicates exist; otherwise sends login success.
Waiting duplicate login sends success only after hasPlayerWithId is false.
Looks up exact profile UUID through PlayerManager.getPlayer.
Main-thread admission refuses a remaining registered same-UUID player before completing spawn.
Removes old world player and list entry before removing matching UUID map entry.
Marks player removed; world entity tick loop skips removed entities.
Ticks open connections; closed connections are removed and their disconnection is handled.

interpretation: For direct unmodified vanilla 1.21.11 and exclusive profile ownership, a fresh authenticated same-profile login after original local closure excludes the old registered player. New loading/site/player/inventory admission is still required. This is not safe old-session reuse.
